items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover matching fittings for the failed indoor heating pipe. Four elbows at €9 gross each total €36.

Section 7.1.8(e) excludes fittings whose dimensions cannot be tied to the documented repair. The only replacement tube listed is 15 mm; if the 28 mm connections are verified, five at €19 gross total €95.
The 28 mm elbow is not substantiated by the listed 15 mm replacement tube, so §7.1.8(e) applies unless a matching connection is documented. One verified fitting would be about €18 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) allows minor installation fixings without requiring an item-by-item match. Eight screws at about €0.80 gross total €6.40.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers necessary pipe supports; the 25 mm size needs to correspond to the repaired assembly, not necessarily the bare tube. Four clamps at €4.50 gross total €18.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover like-for-like replacement of the failed indoor heating pipe. At about €13 gross per metre, 6.4 m totals €83.20.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(g) allow only time attributable to the pipe repair, not the unrelated maintenance. Allow about 3.5 of the 6.75 billed hours at €82 gross per hour, consistent with Case 39, for €287.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(g) limit helper time to necessary assistance on the pipe repair. Allow about 2.5 of the 5.75 billed hours at €45 gross per hour, for €112.50.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstating the pre-loss rock wool insulation. Taking the six pieces as ordinary pipe sections at about €21 gross each, in line with Case 39, gives €126.
Section 7.1.7(c) allows wire used to secure the insulation, but §7.1.8(e) excludes excess quantity. The full 2 kg is unlikely to be necessary for six sections; allow about €5 gross for the wire used.
Section 7.1.7(c) allows a modest lump sum for repair consumables, while §7.1.8(c) bars duplication of listed fittings and wire. Allow €15 gross for distinct incidental materials.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. The sole charge is estimated at €65 gross, consistent with Case 39.

Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of removed pipe and insulation, but not waste from the unrelated floor replacement. If the covered portion can be identified, allow €25 gross for the small volume of plumbing debris.
Sections 3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude repainting the unaffected hallway. If the 12 m² had been affected, €15 gross per m² would total €180.
Sections 7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude the undamaged floor in a separate room. If covered, ordinary removal and like-for-like replacement at €48 gross per m² for 15 m² would total €720.
Section 7.1.8(a) excludes routine servicing unrelated to the heating leak. An ordinary service of this scope would be about €75 gross if eligible.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes separate processing fees added to itemised labour and materials. A nominal €10 gross is provided as the conditional estimate.
